references.matching_note: X has an ordinary open-set topology.
The no-Hausdorff compactness definition uses finite open subcovers.

references.phrase: finite subcollection that still covers X
references.disposition: This is the defining finite-subcover condition, rather than an independent missing contextual meaning.
The clause explicitly denies a separation assumption and should not be construed as a separate dependency on Hausdorff spaces.

review_rationale: Read quasi-compact topological space without a Hausdorff restriction and matched the no-Hausdorff finite-open-subcover formulation of compactness.
